caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table placed against an off-white or light beige background. The table has an oval-shaped top with a smooth surface and is rendered in shades of light to medium brown, giving the appearance of polished wood. The table is supported by four intricately turned legs, also brown, with decorative elements like bulges and grooves. The legs are connected by horizontal and diagonal stretchers, also turned and carved, adding stability and additional visual detail to the table’s structure. The feet of the table are broad and gently curved, each forming a decorative bracket where they touch the ground. In the lower right corner of the image, the name “Rex Dolomith” is written in a simple, clear font. There are no other elements or objects present in the drawing.
title: Three Legged Gate-leg Table
